LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: Order On Behalf Of Payment Validator
LightningComponentBundle.description: Resolves an OrderSummary from a cart Id via PendingOrdSumProcEvent, then listens for OrderSumStatusChangedEvent to show a success/failure result. Auto-advances the flow on success.

property.name: cartId
property.label: Cart Id
property.description: The WebCart Id used to match the OrderSummary via the PendingOrdSumProcEvent.ExternalReferenceIdentifier field.

property.name: successStatus
property.label: Success Status Value
property.description: The OrderSummary.Status value that indicates a successful payment (e.g. Activated).

property.name: failureHeader
property.label: Failure Header
property.description: Headline shown when payment fails (status changes to Hold).

property.name: successMessage
property.label: Success Message
property.default: The payment authorization was successful. Advancing to the next screen…

property.name: failureMessage
property.label: Failure Message
property.description: Headline shown when payment fails (status changes to Hold).
property.default: The payment card experienced a 3D Secure authentication issue. Please navigate to the order summary to collect funds via a merchant-submitted payment or a cash entry payment.

property.name: autoAdvanceDelayMs
property.label: Auto-Advance Delay (ms)
property.description: How long to display the success animation before advancing the flow.

property.name: resolvedStatus
property.label: Resolved Status
property.description: Output: the OrderSummary status value received from the event.

property.name: resolvedOrderSummaryId
property.label: Resolved Order Summary Id
property.description: Output: the OrderSummary Id resolved from the cart Id via PendingOrdSumProcEvent.
